answer.rationale: P99 latency is 5x target on write path in primary region only; this is a localized degradation pattern that regional failover has successfully resolved before (memory_b2, day 33). The security patch cannot be reverted per compliance, eliminating rollback. We're at settlement peak with heavy writes, so we cannot add capacity fast enough or circuit-break without risking customer writes. Routing read replicas (memory_b5) would not address write path latency. Regional failover shifts traffic cleanly, preserves all writes through the failover window, and memory_b2 demonstrates recovery within minutes and error rate stabilization. We verify memory_b2 to confirm the precise mechanics of the prior failover and traffic shift behavior before executing the same pattern at standard scale.
